LanguageData.ColonyCodeW_LetterArrivalText:
{0}, a remote worker, has arrived to take one of your powered agent desks.

Remote workers are friendly residents, not colonists: they do not eat, sleep or need recreation, and you cannot draft or order them. Whenever one of your Claude Code agents is busy, a remote worker embodies it, codes at their desk and walks to the decision terminal when the agent needs you.

Each powered agent desk brings one remote worker (up to three, plus two more for every powered server rack). A remote worker without a powered desk for a day leaves.
LanguageData.ColonyCodeW_DeskFree: No remote worker yet. A powered desk brings one (up to the server rack limit).

LanguageData.ColonyCodeW_GizmoAgentCardDesc: Open the card of the agent this desk's remote worker embodies: state, activity, log and controls.
LanguageData.ColonyCodeW_GizmoReviewDesc: Review this agent's session: worktrees, diffs, and Merge / Request changes / Reject.
LanguageData.ColonyCodeW_GizmoNoAgent: No agent is working at this desk right now.
LanguageData.ColonyCodeW_GizmoNoSession: This agent has no Claude Code session yet.
LanguageData.ColonyCodeW_LetterOfficeText:
Your remote office is online. Start Claude Code with the Colony Code plugin to put {0} to work.

Remote workers are friendly residents, not colonists: they do not eat, sleep or need recreation, and you cannot draft or order them. Whenever one of your Claude Code agents is busy, a remote worker embodies it, codes at their desk and walks to the decision terminal when the agent needs you.

The office uplinks power the office around the clock. Networking is already researched, so you can build more desks, server racks and uplinks later.
LanguageData.ColonyCodeW_LetterOfficeNoRoomLabel: No room for the remote office
LanguageData.ColonyCodeW_LetterOfficeNoRoomText: There was no flat, open spot near your landing site for the starting remote office, so it was not built.\n\nResearch Networking and build agent desks yourself: each powered desk brings one remote worker to embody your Claude Code agents.
